snippet.title: Sea of Remnants | Yo Ho！- First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
Dull.
“Safe, balanced, routine”—life on land drains the soul.

Crank up the noise.
Flapping sails, snoring sailors, captains rambling on—I’ve heard it all.

Let’s just go.
Storm or treasure, ally or enemy—who knows what’s ahead? I’m ready.

That face…
The one holding the memory bottle—why does it feel familiar?

Captain, Sea of Remnants, a brand-new ocean adventure RPG, is about to set sail.
Maybe this isn’t the first time we’ve crossed paths.

More clues:

- Mobile https://www.seaofremnants.com/m/en/
